sections.title: What it does, and what it leaves to you.

items.title: Reads the basics
items.body: The event’s name, date and start time, from the page you paste.

items.title: Asks when there’s a choice
items.body: A page that lists several upcoming events shows them, and you choose one.

items.title: Keeps it private
items.body: The draft sits in your profile. No one can see it, book it or get a message about it.
